title: Divergent
author: Veronica Roth
summary: In a future Chicago where society is split into factions based on virtues, a sixteen-year-old must choose where she belongs. She picks the daring faction and discovers that her own mind is a danger to the system.
readIf: you like fast, action-filled young-adult dystopias with a tough training section and a slow-burning romance.
skipIf: you want a deeply original world, since the faction idea works better as a hook than as a believable society.

pairings.reason: The model for this kind of story, with a more tightly drawn heroine and higher stakes.
Another quick, puzzle-driven young-adult dystopia about teens in a harsh controlled setting.
A shorter, gentler and more reflective look at a controlled society.
